name: Жим гантелей на наклонной
pose: lying back on an adjustable incline bench set to about 35 degrees, pressing two dumbbells straight up above the upper chest with arms almost fully extended, feet flat on the floor
view: three-quarter front view from the side of the bench
highlight: upper chest muscles (clavicular head of the pectoralis major)

name: Жим штанги лёжа
pose: lying on a flat bench, holding a barbell loaded with weight plates above the chest with arms extended, feet flat on the floor
view: three-quarter front view from the side of the bench, slightly from above

name: Приседания со штангой
pose: back squat with a barbell loaded with weight plates resting on the upper back, at the bottom position with thighs parallel to the floor, chest up, feet shoulder-width apart

name: Становая тяга
pose: conventional barbell deadlift, mid-lift with the loaded barbell just below the knees, back flat, hips hinged, arms straight
highlight: lower back muscles (erector spinae), glutes and hamstrings

name: Тяга верхнего блока
pose: seated at a lat pulldown cable machine with knees under the pads, pulling a long wide bar down to the upper chest with elbows pointing down
view: three-quarter rear view so the back is visible

name: Махи гантелями в стороны
pose: standing upright, raising two dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height with slightly bent elbows
view: front view, slightly from the side
